## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Identify the relevant plan
sections and any affected contract, data source, or interface.

## Evidence

List the commands run and their results. Link the fixture, independent calculation,
or replayable export that demonstrates the change. Explain skipped checks.

## Assumptions and limits

Identify remaining synthetic or assumed inputs, coverage and sampling limits,
schema compatibility, and any new source attribution or redistribution terms.
